about: Public gwz-git capabilities that have no production caller in gwz-core today (convergence plan step 5.5, rule R9; read check_gwz_git_adoption.py's docstring). Each entry says which rows own it, why it is unconsumed, what ends the exception, and the date it was recorded. The list is a ratchet: an entry whose capability gains a caller, or names nothing, fails until it is deleted. A new public capability with no caller fails by name; recording it here is a reviewed act, not a default. Keys are Owner::name as the checker prints them.

unconsumed.reason: G0 foundation (owned CommitRecord of one full-id commit). Core reads commits through its own rows still on a native handle (log, merge, preservation); no row that moved needs it.
unconsumed.exit: first consumer is the row that moves commit reads (G7 history cursor or a G10 decision), or the capability is removed at that decision

unconsumed.reason: A1. gwz-git's native commit and tag open through it (route::open delegates, round 1 remediation C-P3-3), so it has a consumer inside gwz-git; gwz-core has none, and R9 asks for a production consumer in core, which this is not. Core opens with open_exact and never needs Git's variables to choose a repository's parts; the first core-side consumer would be G3 (stage, checkout) if it is moved.
unconsumed.exit: the G3 decision: a core caller exists, or the method becomes crate-private (native commit then opens through the crate-private form)

unconsumed.reason: Accessor for the libgit2 code, class and message of a failure. Core translates through Error::kind and Error::message; nothing branches on a native code yet.
unconsumed.exit: step 5.4 (G5/G6) if the credential-helper classification reads the native code; otherwise removed or recorded as a decision

unconsumed.reason: Companion accessor of ObjectId. Core asks the repository (Repository::object_format) and builds ids from it.
unconsumed.exit: first consumer in a later row, or removed at the Phase 6 API review

unconsumed.reason: Consumed by a driver, not by core: gwz-cli builds the notes (gwz-cli/src/globalargs/dispatch.rs:43) through core's `git::RouteNotes` re-export and core only stores and forwards them. This check reads gwz-core alone, so it cannot see that caller.
unconsumed.exit: when this check also reads the drivers, or the notes sink moves so that core constructs it

unconsumed.reason: Test facility: forces the Git CLI route to compare it with the native one. Behind the gwz-git cargo feature `test-support`, which gwz-core enables in [dev-dependencies] only (round 1 remediation C-P3-4), so production gwz-core cannot force a route; its consumers are gwz-core's spawn-gate tests and gwz-git's own.
unconsumed.exit: stays while the differential tests need it; it is not a production capability and leaves the public surface if gwz-git is published without the feature

unconsumed.reason: The builder that carries RoutePolicy::CLI_ONLY; same feature gate and same reason as that entry. Core's production code builds Services without it.
